:::{#exr-var-mse-bias}
#### Squared standard error from pMSE and bias

Using @thm-mse-bias-variance,
write the squared [standard error](#def-SE) $\sqf{\SE{\hparam}}$
in terms of the [pMSE](#def-mse) and the [bias](#def-bias) of $\hparam$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-var-mse-bias}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\pMSE{\hparam} &= \sqf{\bias{\hparam}} + \Var{\hparam}
&& \text{(MSE equals bias squared plus variance)}\\
\Var{\hparam} &= \pMSE{\hparam} - \sqf{\bias{\hparam}}
&& \text{(subtract $\sqf{\bias{\hparam}}$ from both sides)}\\
\sqf{\SD{\hparam}} &= \pMSE{\hparam} - \sqf{\bias{\hparam}}
&& \text{($\Var{\hparam} = \sqf{\SD{\hparam}}$)}\\
\sqf{\SE{\hparam}} &= \pMSE{\hparam} - \sqf{\bias{\hparam}}
&& \text{(definition of standard error: $\SE{\hparam} = \SD{\hparam}$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
